narrative: 当消失点落在人物之外，前方还有很长的路要走。空间掌控着未来。
身体是一道门槛，而非祭坛。如果消失点落在脸上，建筑就像武器或祝福一样瞄准着他们。
在一个没有透视平行线汇聚的平面立面上，这个手法就用错了。一块不会汇聚的背景板无法提供消失点。
那样你其实是在指认一个不存在的幽灵。单点、两点和三点透视都有各自的消失点。
构图上的抉择在于你把消失点放在哪里，以及主体是挡住它、占据它，还是被它无视。
how: 站在真正有平行线汇聚的地方：铁轨、公路、柱廊。选择高度（与眼平行的机位会让消失点靠近地平线；低机位则会把它抬高）。
把主体放在消失点上、放在它前面，或让它偏离消失点。更广的镜头会让被吸向无限远处的效果更加剧烈。
提示词：Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate.
when: 当距离本身就是意义所在时使用：一条路、一座车站、一个着陆点，一段尚未走完的人生。不要在一个平坦浅显的房间里硬说这是消失点构图。
vs: 单点透视是一种特殊情形——只有一个通常位于轴线上的消失点，摄影机正对着它摆放。消失点构图可以是一个两点透视的街角，汇聚点偏在一侧。
引导线（Leading Lines）引导视线，却可能永远不在画面内相交。极远景（Extreme Long Shot）常常包含一个遥远的消失点。
消失点是图解里的一个位置，而不是一种景别。
examples_film: 《德州巴黎》（Paris, Texas）把道路和铁轨对准一条在男人停下后依然延伸的地平线。《第三类接触》（Close Encounters of the Third Kind）用着陆点的透视构建出一场与来自消失点之物的相遇。
车站、码头和沙漠公路都是同一种语法：无限远处成了一个角色。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是一个居中的人物，却没有汇聚的线条。破绽是一个人站在平坦场地中央，提示词里只写了“消失”二字。
解决办法是加入真正向远处汇聚的平行线，或者干脆改用中心构图，不要再声称这是透视构图。

faq.q: 电影中的“消失点”是什么？
faq.a: 这是画面中平行线看起来相交的位置。道路、铁轨和长廊都指向那里。构图上，它是一个终点：在人物之外、在人物身上，或偏向一侧。

faq.q: 消失点 vs 单点透视
faq.a: 单点透视使用单一的消失点，摄影机正对某个平面，通常位于轴线上。两点透视的建筑转角画面里同样存在消失点。单点透视是一种结构方式，消失点则是那个汇聚点本身。

faq.q: 什么时候该用消失点构图？
faq.a: 当距离应该发挥作用时使用：道路、铁轨、教堂中殿，任何还有很长路要走的场景。在浅显平坦、没有汇聚边线的房间里就不要用了。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写消失点的提示词？
faq.a: 说明平行线以及它们相交的位置。示例：Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate. 如果消失点应该落在身体上，就说消失点落在胸口，建筑正瞄准他们。

narrative: There is a long way still to go when the point sits beyond the figure. Space owns the future.
The body is a threshold, not the altar. If the point sits on the face, the architecture aims at them like a weapon or a blessing.
It is the wrong tool in a flat elevation with no receding parallels. A painted backdrop that does not converge cannot offer a vanishing point.
You would be naming a ghost. One-point, two-point, and three-point perspective all have vanishing points.
The compositional choice is where you put them, and whether the subject blocks, occupies, or is ignored by that meeting.
how: Stand where real parallels recede: tracks, a highway, a colonnade. Choose height (eye-level keeps the point near the horizon; a low camera lifts it).
Place the subject on the point, in front of it, or off it. A wider lens makes the suck toward infinity more violent.
Prompt: Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate.
when: Use it when distance is the meaning: a road, a station, a landing site, a life still unwalked. Do not claim a vanishing point in a flat, shallow room.
vs: One-Point Perspective is the special case of a single, often axial, vanishing point with the camera squared. Vanishing-point composition can be a two-point street corner with the meeting off to the side.
Leading Lines steer the eye but may never meet in frame. Extreme Long Shot often includes a distant point.
The point is a location in the diagram, not a shot size.
examples_film: Paris, Texas aims roads and rails at a horizon that keeps going after the man stops. Close Encounters builds landing-site perspective as a meeting with something that arrives from the point.
Stations, docks, and desert highways are the same grammar: infinity as a character.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a centered figure with no converging lines. The tell is a person in the middle of a flat field and a prompt that only says vanishing.
The fix is to include actual receding parallels, or to switch to Centered Composition and stop claiming perspective.

faq.q: What is a vanishing point in film?
faq.a: It is where parallel lines appear to meet in the picture. Roads, rails, and halls aim there. Compositionally it is a destination: beyond the figure, on the figure, or off to one side.

One-point perspective uses a single vanishing point and a camera squared to a plane, often on axis. A vanishing point also exists in two-point views of a building corner. One-point is a construction. The vanishing point is the meeting itself.

faq.q: When should I use vanishing point?
faq.a: Use it when distance should act: roads, tracks, naves, anything that still has a long way to go. Skip it in shallow, flat rooms with no receding edges.

faq.q: How do I prompt vanishing point for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the parallels and where they meet. Example: Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate. If the point should sit on the body, say vanishing point on the chest, architecture aiming at them.
